title: Making a AI assisted slay the spire inspired card game with guns and RNG
author: FinalForgeStudios
selftext:
Our game in development is C.A.P.Y He's Got a licence to chill... and a flash bang , we are a trio group wanting to make a video game, we used AI really made everything allot faster. We used Pixel lab, Chat GPT, Gemini AI Suno for the music on godot engine :D The game balancing needs allot of work... unfortunately AI can't help with this. 

You can Try it in [https://final-forge-studio.itch.io/capy-hes-got-a-licence-to-chill-and-a-flashbang](https://final-forge-studio.itch.io/capy-hes-got-a-licence-to-chill-and-a-flashbang)

replies.author: FinalForgeStudios
replies.body: Whoa cool card army battler ! Tried it the initial mechanics are solid :D , but the visual assets needs improvement I could recommend pixel lab but they make pixel model sprite sheets :D ! Just dont stop every step is progress until everything is just done :D !!

comments.author: Smok3dSalmon
comments.body: The card use sound is too loud and out of place. I like the background art

replies.author: FinalForgeStudios
replies.body: Thanks for the feed back we still are working on the audio effects :D

replies.author: Smok3dSalmon
replies.body: Maybe you could try something like a dart hitting a dart board. Or a thick card slapping onto a table like it's being played with enthusiasm.

replies.author: FinalForgeStudios
replies.body: Oh will try this prompt :D I like the enthusiasm part hehe !

comments.author: Syphorce
comments.body: Slay the spire is much more than this card game loop. How are you implementing the meta progression?

replies.author: FinalForgeStudios
replies.body: Yes I'm a fan of slay the spire 1 & 2 but there are no talent trees only unlocking cards and the architect just talks to you before spouting some numbers then kills you. We have a resettable level progressive talent tree for builds, special equipment that you can bring on a run and a faction style story progression where you can pick the moraly good side, the bad side or the guys why just want to save people :D

replies.author: FinalForgeStudios
replies.body: Yes Capybarass :D ! the area is like a mixed areas of the Philippines :D

comments.author: GregInPlay
comments.body: How did you get the assets for your game? Does AI have any capacity to help with that?

replies.author: FinalForgeStudios
replies.body: for models pixel lab :D but like other ai it will slightly drive you less insane, the downside of pixel lab it can't make giant enemies :D , background is mixed of gemini ai , chat gpt and grok :D !

replies.author: GregInPlay
